evidence.reason: The finding is a real TOCTOU defect in verify_archive: line 688 hashes the archive pathname, while line 698 passes the same pathname to _safe_extract, which reopens it. A replacement archive introduced between those operations can satisfy its own manifest/inventory checks and reach smoke execution while the report still returns the originally hashed digest. Nothing in the current contract records this as an accepted limitation. Copying the archive into private temporary storage before hashing and extracting from that copy is a routine correctness fix.
